<!--- Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above -->

#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
Provide base classes for all framework models.

#### Related Issue
<!--- This project only accepts pull requests related to open issues -->
<!--- If suggesting a new feature or change, please discuss it in an issue first -->
<!--- If fixing a bug, there should be an issue describing it with steps to reproduce -->
<!--- Please link to the issue here: -->
Closes #1991 

#### Motivation and Context
<!--- Why is this change required? What problem does it solve? -->
If we need to modify the interfaces (such as for the universe selection model refresh #1977), then we don't want to break existing user code. By providing a base class we make it easier to be backwards compatible.

#### Requires Documentation Change
<!--- Please indicate if these changes will require updates to documentation, and if so, specify what changes are required -->
Yes -- all examples should derive from the base classes to ensure users have backwards compatible code if/when the interface definitions change.

<!--- Please describe in detail how you tested your changes. -->
<!--- Include details of your testing environment, and the tests you ran to -->
<!--- see how your change affects other areas of the code, etc. -->
Mechanical refactoring, existing tests pass, solution builds.

issue_context.title: No base class for framework models
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
Each framework has a base case which can be used for inheritance.

#### Actual Behavior
New framework models can on implement the interface.

#### Potential Solution
Create a base classe for each framework interface.

#### Checklist
